name: soft-key-goal
task: Grab the key, and after that get to the goal square if you can.
texts: The key must be grabbed at least once.
Reaching the goal must not occur before the key is grabbed.
Ideally, after grabbing the key, the agent should reach the goal.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u1
REJECTING_STATES: u2
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_goal&has_key) -> u1
(u0, at_goal&!has_key) -> u2
(u0, at_goal&has_key) -> u1
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_goal&has_key, u1) -> 7
(u0, at_goal&!has_key, u2) -> -100.839
(u0, at_goal&has_key, u1) -> 12
